question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Intermitence**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word is '**Intermittence**'.
 
• The incorrect option lacks an extra '**t**' in the word.
 
• The word means the action of stopping and starting again at intervals. (बीच-बीच में रुकने और दोबारा शुरू करने की क्रिया)
 
• It is a noun and is often used in medical or technical contexts.
 
 
• **Example**: *The intermittence of the power supply caused the computer to shut down multiple times.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cholera **is a disease caused by bacteria in contaminated water or food. (कॉलेरा)
 
• **Phlegm **is a thick, sticky substance produced by the respiratory system to trap and remove foreign particles. (सर्दी, बलग़म)
 
• **Psalm **is a sacred song or poem used in religious worship. (धर्मगीत)
